status: frozen-wire-contract; application-use-cases-ready; registered CLI/service adapter routes pending

compatibility.unknown_object_fields: ignored by v1 readers for additive compatibility
compatibility.paths: locators only; content and lineage use project-scoped source_version_id plus digest

work.artifact.inspect/v1.outcome: GeneralWorkMutationResultDto<null>; readback is ArtifactEvidenceListDto; never a command receipt

work.wait.create/v1.outcome: GeneralWorkMutationResultDto<null>; open structured wait blocks that work and dependent edges only

work.wait.resolve/v1.outcome: GeneralWorkMutationResultDto<null>; append-only attributed resolution or cancellation; task completion remains separate

work.inputs.read/v1.outcome: optional immutable AcceptedInputSetReadDto, including the exact set header even when it contains no bindings

work.artifact.evidence.read/v1.outcome: optional ArtifactEvidenceListDto with attributed inspection and decision history from one SQLite snapshot

work.acceptance.read/v1.outcome: OutputCoverageDto with source, contract, input, and proof revisions; latest exact submission identity; covered requirement keys; required/optional gaps; stale/rejected observations; and safe next operations
work.acceptance.read/v1.read_consistency: single SQLite read transaction; stale expected project revision is rejected

work.wait.list/v1.input: project_id, optional work_id, include_terminal, expected_project_revision, now_utc_ms
work.wait.list/v1.outcome: ExternalWaitListDto with source revision, active blocked work IDs, due and overdue follow-up wait IDs, and attributed terminal history
work.wait.list/v1.read_consistency: result is rejected if project revision changes during the bounded read

rules: date-only values retain their civil date and IANA timezone
date-only years are bounded to the round-trippable YYYY range 0001 through 9999
instant midnight is an exact instant, not a date-only value
missing follow-up is allowed and does not erase an open wait

rigor_profiles_v1.lightweight@1: completion attestation; no invented executable proof
rigor_profiles_v1.deliverables-validated@1: required output coverage and attributable automatic inspection
rigor_profiles_v1.software-verification@1: existing registered software verification gates remain required

legacy_gate_policy.legacy_contract_absent: existing pinned focused/reviewed behavior is unchanged
legacy_gate_policy.new_general_rigor: lightweight, deliverables-validated, or reviewed-artifacts selected on draft work makes legacy checkpoint/verification/review gates nonblocking while preserving their immutable facts; summary and other non-command gates remain
legacy_gate_policy.published_work: a first contract or accepted input set on already-open work requires an explicit amendment reason; a first contract preserves existing gate policy
legacy_gate_policy.amendments: append contract/input and proof revisions with bounded reasons; an explicit nonsoftware rigor amendment may update effective legacy gate requiredness while immutable declarations/facts remain; active attempts and closed/cancelled work cannot be amended
